description: Set up the phone line: claim a number (pick one from search_numbers or just give an area code), name the persona, and register the owner's mobile. An account can own several lines; each needs its own paid plan (if none is waiting, this returns a checkout link). Ask the owner before opting them in to texts.

agent_email.description: An inbox your agent reads (e.g. an AgentMail address). Owner instructions are emailed there instantly, with an hourly digest of anything unacknowledged, plus every call debrief.

handle.description: Short handle for handle@cosvoice.com. Defaults from name.

owner_phone.description: Owner's mobile. Calls/texts from it are treated as instructions.

plan.description: starter $29/100 min · plus $79/300 min · pro $199/1000 min; overage $0.25/min.

sms_opt_in.description: Owner agreed to receive texts from the line (delivery starts once carrier registration is complete).

title: Create the line
